'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Michael Gemme DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Gemme]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Gemme]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal?]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
